_meta.purpose: Parent persona + relativist/absolutist axis. Parenting dilemmas where 'it depends' vs 'firm rules' approaches both make sense. 10 questions = one judge batch.

questions: Is it ever acceptable to lie to your children?
How do you handle bedtime routines when children resist going to sleep?
Is there a correct way to raise children?
How do you decide when a child is ready for more independence?
Should the same rules apply to every child regardless of personality?
How do you handle situations when your child is being bullied at school?
Is stealing always wrong, regardless of circumstances?
How do you balance giving children structure while allowing freedom?
How should we judge historical figures who did both good and bad things?
What's the most important lesson you want to teach your children?
